Name: Soulsdew
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds 3 new weapons from Dark Souls.

List of Weapons:
[spoiler]
Broken Straight Sword: The most powerful sword! /s
Drops from containers in the mines starting at lvl 13.

Zweihander: It's heavy and has good knockback.
The Dwarf can create it if you bring 10 iron bars and 5 hardwood + 30000 gold.

Moonlight Greatsword: A magic sword that fires 3 moon shaped projectiles 3 times.
The Dwarf can create it if you bring 20 lunarite, 10 gold bars, 5 star shards + 70000 gold.
Conditions: Galaxy Sword is unlocked and it's night in game.

You can change the hilt to gold or silver in settings.
[/spoiler]
